mirahezerequests-extensionname:
{{optional}}
The name of this extension, used in [[Special:Version]] and elsewhere.
mirahezerequests-success: Shown after a request has been submitted successfully. $1 is a link to the request, allowing the requester (or a handler) to view its status.
mirahezerequests-label-accept: Button label for accepting a request. {{Identical|Accept request}}
mirahezerequests-label-decline: Button label for declining a request.
mirahezerequests-label-decline-reason: Field label for the (required) reason given when declining a request.
mirahezerequests-label-requested-date: Field label for the date/time a request was submitted.
mirahezerequests-request-accepted: Shown after a request has been accepted.
mirahezerequests-request-declined: Shown after a request has been declined.
requestaccount: Page title for [[Special:RequestAccount]], the form used to request a new account.
requestaccount-email: Field label on the account request form asking for the requester's email address.
requestaccount-username: Field label on the account request form asking for the desired username.
requestaccount-reason: Field label on the account request form asking why the requester couldn't create the account themselves.
requestaccount-created-email-text:
Body of the email sent when an account request is approved.

Parameters:
* $1 - the username
* $2 - the temporary password
* $3 - URL of [[Special:UserLogin]]
* $4 - how long the temporary password is valid, as a duration
requestaccount-created-email-title: Subject line of the email sent when an account request is approved.
requestaccount-declined-email-text: Body of the email sent when an account request is declined. $1 is the reason given by the handler.
requestaccount-declined-email-title: Subject line of the email sent when an account request is declined.
requestaccount-explanation: Field label/help text on the account request form asking the requester to describe the issue they faced.
requestaccount-section-details: Tab/section heading for the read-only details of an account request.
requestaccount-section-handling: Tab/section heading for the controls used by handlers to accept or decline an account request.
requestaccount-abusefilter-label: Option label for one of the possible reasons a requester couldn't create an account themselves: they were blocked by [[mw:Extension:AbuseFilter|AbuseFilter]].
requestaccount-captcha-label: Option label for one of the possible reasons a requester couldn't create an account themselves: they couldn't pass the CAPTCHA.
requestaccount-globalblock-label: Option label for one of the possible reasons a requester couldn't create an account themselves: their IP address is globally blocked.
requestaccount-other-label: Option label for 'some other reason', one of the possible reasons a requester couldn't create an account themselves. {{Identical|Other}}
requestaccountqueue: Page title for [[Special:RequestAccountQueue]], the list of submitted account requests.
logentry-requestaccount-accept:
Log entry shown when an account request is accepted. Parameters:
* $1 - the performer
* $4 - the requested username
logentry-requestaccount-decline:
Log entry shown when an account request is declined. Parameters:
* $1 - the performer
* $4 - the requested username
mirahezerequests-label-completed-date: Field label for the date/time a request was resolved (accepted, declined, or failed).
mirahezerequests-label-donetby: Field label for the user who resolved a request.
mirahezerequests-label-ip: Field label for the IP address a request was submitted from. Only shown to users allowed to see it (see $wgMirahezeRequestsIPVisibilityGroups).
mirahezerequests-label-reason: Field label for the notes/reason recorded when a request was resolved.
mirahezerequests-label-status: Field label for a request's current status. {{Identical|Status}}
mirahezerequests-notfound: Error shown when trying to view a request ID that doesn't exist (e.g. a stale or mistyped link).
mirahezerequests-notcentral: Page title of the error shown when a page that only works on the central requests wiki is accessed elsewhere.
mirahezerequests-notcentral-text: Body text of the error shown when a page that only works on the central requests wiki is accessed elsewhere.
mirahezerequests-status-complete: Name of the 'complete' request status: the request was accepted and completed successfully. {{Identical|Complete}}
mirahezerequests-status-conflict: Error shown when trying to accept/decline a request that has already been resolved (e.g. two handlers acting on it at once).
mirahezerequests-status-pending: Name of the 'pending' request status: not yet actioned by a handler. {{Identical|Pending}}
mirahezerequests-status-starting: Name of the 'starting' request status: a handler has accepted the request and it is currently being processed.
mirahezerequests-status-mailfailed: Request status when the account exists but its notification email failed; a handler can retry delivery.
mirahezerequests-status-sending: Request status while the account notification email is being sent.
requestaccount-resend: Button to generate a new temporary password and retry the account notification email.
requestaccount-error-reissue-email: Error when the account's current confirmed email differs from the requested address, preventing password reissue.
requestaccount-notes-mail-interrupted: Note recorded if sending an account notification throws an exception. A handler can retry delivery.
logentry-requestaccount-resend: Log entry for retrying an account notification. {{logentry}} $4 is the requested username.
mirahezerequests-status-all: Option label meaning 'show requests of any status', used in the status filter on the request queue. {{Identical|All}}
mirahezerequests-tab-closed: Tab label for the list of resolved (closed) requests.
mirahezerequests-tab-open: Tab label for the list of unresolved (open) requests.
requestaccount-comments: Field label for optional additional comments on the account request form.
requestaccount-consent: Checkbox label on the account request form; the requester must consent to their request being reviewed and their email being used to create the account.
requestaccount-email-short: Short column header for the requester's email address, used in the request queue table. {{Identical|Email}}
requestaccount-explanation-help: Help text shown under the explanation field on the account request form.
requestaccount-log-header: Header shown at the top of [[Special:Log/requestaccount]].
requestaccount-log-name: Name of the log type used to record account request approvals/declines, shown in [[Special:Log]].
requestaccount-notes-created: Resolution note recorded when an account request is accepted and the account is created successfully.
requestaccount-notes-created-mail-failed: Resolution note recorded when an account is created successfully but the notification email could not be sent. $1 is the mail error.
requestaccount-reason-help: Help text shown under the reason field on the account request form.
requestaccount-username-help: Help text shown under the username field on the account request form.
requestaccount-username-invalid: Validation error shown when the requested username isn't a valid username (e.g. contains disallowed characters).
requestaccount-username-short: Short column header for the requested username, used in the request queue table. {{Identical|Username}}
action-request-account:
Used as $1 in {{msg-mw|actionpermissiontext}}, e.g. when a blocked or restricted user tries to submit an account request.
{{doc-action|request-account}}
action-handle-requestaccount:
Used as $1 in {{msg-mw|actionpermissiontext}}, e.g. when a user without the right tries to accept/decline an account request.
{{doc-action|handle-requestaccount}}
requestaccount-closed: Shown on [[Special:RequestAccount]] instead of the form while $wgRequestAccountOpen is false.
requestaccount-confirm-email-title: Subject of the email confirmation email.
requestaccount-confirm-email-text:
Body of the email confirmation email. Plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - requested username
* $2 - confirmation URL
* $3 - IP address the request was submitted from
* $4 - time until the link expires, e.g. "1 day"
requestaccount-confirm-info:
Text of the email confirmation form.

Parameters:
* $1 - requested username
requestaccount-confirm-invalid: Error shown when an email confirmation link is invalid or expired.
requestaccount-confirm-legend: Legend of the email confirmation form.
requestaccount-confirm-submit:
Button label of the email confirmation form.
{{Identical|Confirm}}
requestaccount-confirm-success: Shown after the email address was confirmed, which submits the request.
requestaccount-creation-reason:
Reason recorded in the user creation log when an account is created from a request. Wikitext, because log comments are rendered as wikitext.

Parameters:
* $1 - wikitext link to the request, displayed as its number, e.g. "#12"
requestaccount-decline-mail-failed: Shown after a request was declined but the decline email could not be sent.
requestaccount-error-captcha: Error shown when the CAPTCHA was not solved.
requestaccount-error-create-unexpected: Error shown to a handler when account creation asked for additional input, such as a redirect to an external provider.
requestaccount-error-duplicate-email: Error shown when a pending or unconfirmed request for the same email address exists.
requestaccount-error-duplicate-username: Error shown when a pending request for the same username exists.
requestaccount-error-email-disabled: Error shown when email is disabled on the wiki.
requestaccount-error-email-send: Error shown when the confirmation email could not be sent.
requestaccount-error-no-action: Error shown when the request viewer form was submitted without pressing a button.
requestaccount-ip-purged: Shown instead of the IP address once it has been removed after the retention period.
requestaccount-iplink-block: Link text to [[Special:Block]] for the IP address of a request. Only shown to users who can block.
requestaccount-iplink-blocklist: Link text to [[Special:BlockList]] for the IP address of a request.
requestaccount-iplink-blocklog: Link text to the block log for the IP address of a request.
requestaccount-iplink-globalblock: Link text to Special:GlobalBlock for the IP address of a request. Only shown to users who can block globally.
requestaccount-iplink-globalblocklist: Link text to Special:GlobalBlockList for the IP address of a request.
requestaccount-label-same-email: Label for the list of other requests made with the same (normalized) email address, shown on a request.
requestaccount-same-email-all: Link to the queue filtered by the email address, shown when there are more requests than listed.
requestaccount-same-email-none:
Shown when no other request used the same email address.
{{Identical|None}}
requestaccount-success:
Shown after the request form was submitted and the confirmation email was sent. Should make clear that the request is not submitted until the link is confirmed.

Parameters:
* $1 - email address the confirmation email was sent to
* $2 - time until the link expires, e.g. "1 day"
requestaccount-warning-name-check: Shown above the message of a username check (TitleBlacklist, AntiSpoof) that refused the name when the request was submitted.
requestaccount-warning-ip-blocked: Shown to handlers who cannot see the requester's IP address when that address is blocked. The block target is hidden because it contains the IP address or range.
requestaccount-warning-not-creatable:
Warning shown to handlers when the account cannot be created.

Parameters:
* $1 - requested username
* $2 - reason why the account cannot be created
mirahezerequests-error-too-long:
Error shown under a free-text field (an answer, a comment or a reason) whose input is longer than allowed.

Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of characters
requestaccount-globalblock-reason: Field label on the account request form, shown only when the requester chose that their IP address is globally blocked.
mirahezerequests-status-unconfirmed: Status of an account request whose email address has not been confirmed yet. Such requests are not shown in the queue.
logentry-requestaccount-request:
Log entry for an account request whose email address was confirmed, which puts it into the queue.

Parameters:
* $1 - the system user, as the requester has no account
* $4 - the requested username
ipb-action-request-account:
{{doc-actionlink}}
Action that a partial block can prevent: submitting [[Special:RequestAccount]].
mirahezerequests-label-requester: Field label for the user who submitted a request.
mirahezerequests-requester-anonymous: Placeholder in the requester column of the queue for a request submitted while logged out, when the viewer cannot see the requester's IP address.
mirahezerequests-nopermission: Error shown when a user tries to view a request they aren't allowed to see (not a handler, and not the person who submitted it).
requestaccount-ccemail: Checkbox label on the account request form, letting a logged-in requester opt in to being CC'd on the decision email.
